FIELDS.NAME: TimberWorks Carpentry
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At TimberWorks Carpentry, we specialize in custom woodworking and carpentry projects focusing on non-structural interior work. Our operations involve the meticulous design and crafting of furniture, cabinetry, and interior installations, utilizing modern equipment and techniques. We prioritize safety and efficiency, ensuring all staff are well-trained in safety protocols and that our workshop complies with all local zoning and fire protection regulations. With a commitment to quality, we source materials from reputable suppliers and have established comprehensive processes for customer consultations and project approvals. We maintain a clean environment by employing dust control systems and ensure that our workshop has no flammable or toxic chemical handling on-site. Through these practices, we demonstrate our dedication to delivering top-quality carpentry while managing risk effectively.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 08/15/2022, Cause: Accidental equipment failure resulting in minor injury and property damage, Amount: $1,500, Status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday - Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Saturday: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire Resistant Safe, Class 1, UL Listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: On-site security personnel for monitoring workshop operations and access control.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – TimberWorks Carpentry does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Their operations focus on non-structural interior work, with no handling of flammable or toxic chemicals on-site.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – TimberWorks Carpentry does not sponsor any athletic teams as their focus is primarily on custom woodworking and carpentry projects.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our operations manager, John Smith, to ensure compliance and transfer of risk.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – TimberWorks Carpentry has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. The company maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices in all its operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – TimberWorks Carpentry has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. The company maintains a strong track record with its insurance providers.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – TimberWorks Carpentry does not lease employees to or from other employers, as all personnel are directly employed by the company to ensure quality and safety in operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – TimberWorks Carpentry does not carry Workers' Compensation insurance; however, we fully comply with legal requirements and prioritize safety and employee welfare in our operations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – TimberWorks Carpentry also owns and operates "Custom Furniture Designs LLC," which focuses on bespoke furniture creation. This business complements our main operations in carpentry and woodworking.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – TimberWorks Carpentry currently has one active insurance policy with this company, and there are no additional policies to report.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – TimberWorks Carpentry is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging products. Our operations strictly focus on custom woodworking and carpentry projects without engaging in any manufacturing activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – TimberWorks Carpentry does not rent or loan equipment to others, as we focus on our internal custom woodworking and carpentry projects to maintain quality and safety.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – TimberWorks Carpentry has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial standing.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – TimberWorks Carpentry does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus exclusively on non-structural interior work without handling any hazardous materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – TimberWorks Carpentry does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are focused on non-structural interior work with no engagement in high-risk activities. We prioritize safety and compliance in all aspects of our business.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – TimberWorks Carpentry has had no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a strong commitment to ethical practices and compliance in all operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – TimberWorks Carpentry has no uncorrected fire code violations and complies with all local fire protection regulations.
